title: Gratitude Streak Break Detector
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log
| stats latest(_time) as last_gratitude, count as total_entries
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_gratitude)/86400,0), at_risk=if(days_since>=2,1,0)
description: Shows when a gratitude habit has gone quiet for a couple of days and may need a nudge.
value: Small, positive habits are easy to drop during stressful weeks; detecting the break early is better than restarting from scratch later.
implementation: Send gratitude entries to `index=personal`; alert when the gap since the last entry passes your threshold.
visualization: Single-value tile of days since last gratitude log.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when your gratitude habit has gone quiet for a few days, so you can pick it back up quickly.
